papers.title: Responsibility-Carrying State
papers.current_ceiling: The three-valued transport law is exact on 750 cases; P13B is bounded-ready, while P13A empirical safety/cost authority is withheld because it is self-scored.
post_matrix_updates: Commit 87e2bcb recovered external-responsibility-transport and prospective organization-disjoint materials, preserving NEGATIVE_HISTORY.
PR #1691 owns live-Git acquisition and must not be duplicated.
load_bearing_adverse: Optimistic collapse is unsound 212 times; pessimistic collapse over-revokes 84 times.
UNKNOWN is a third outcome and cannot be coerced into reuse/revoke.
The old 31-repo/14-organization corpus cannot establish organization-disjoint external reuse.
A non-head-reuse design with no true positive class would be non-discriminating.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: The active organization-disjoint campaign needs native/external gold for genuinely reusable non-head states and must test safety, over-revocation and abstention under real responsibility drift.
papers.decisive_question: Across organization-disjoint repositories, can the frozen three-valued responsibility rule safely authorize genuinely correct non-head reuse while avoiding both optimistic unsoundness and pessimistic over-revocation?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: Responsibility-scoped sufficiency enables safe, useful reuse across real organizational and semantic drift, with UNKNOWN preserved as a principled outcome.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: Relative to native tests/maintainers, the rule should make zero unsound reuse decisions, recover a prospectively positive non-head-reuse class and reduce unnecessary revocation.
papers.population_or_universe: Version-pinned organization-disjoint repositories/workflows outside the old corpus, sourced through the active E5/E6/E7/E15 acquisition lane.
papers.unit_of_analysis: Repository version transition × future responsibility × candidate reusable state.
historical_only_inputs: The old 31-repo/14-organization corpus and all 750 transport-law cases
design: Defer data acquisition to #1691 and preserve its V1 adverse/V2/V3 receipts.
Define true reusable and unsafe non-head classes before scoring.
Use native tests, build/provenance verifiers and independent maintainer adjudication for residual cases.
Compare three-valued, optimistic, pessimistic and head-only policies.
Measure safety, useful reuse, over-revocation, abstention and cost.
primary_endpoints: Unsound reuse, with zero as a noncompensatory gate.
negative_controls: Gold unavailable case that must remain UNKNOWN/CANNOT_CHECK.
analysis_plan: Exact case-level safety plus organization-cluster intervals.
Design power is assessed before efficacy: absence of a positive non-head class yields CANNOT_CHECK_DESIGN_POWER.
No old-corpus outcome enters the fresh estimate.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Freeze all eligible organization-disjoint transitions under #1691 and require a predeclared minimum positive non-head-reuse class before efficacy grading.
papers.success_gate: Zero unsound reuse, independently verified positive non-head reuse and lower over-revocation than head-only/pessimistic baselines across multiple organizations.
papers.refutation_gate: Any unsound reuse refutes the safety claim; no positive class yields CANNOT_CHECK_DESIGN_POWER rather than a false negative.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if live-Git/license bindings, organization disjointness, native gold or positive-class prevalence cannot be established.
papers.authority_required: Native verifiers and independent maintainers/domain adjudicators; self-scored P13A endpoints do not count.

active_lane.collision_rule: Do not duplicate acquisition, relabel V1 adverse receipts or inspect old-corpus outcomes as fresh confirmation.

immediate_safe_actions: Review #1691 bindings and unresolved CANNOT_CHECK rows.
Write a gold-authority hierarchy for each responsibility type.
Prove that the frozen task set contains a genuinely discriminating non-head positive class before efficacy grading.
forbidden_actions: Do not self-score P13A safety authority.
Do not call a no-positive-class design evidence against useful reuse.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier software/provenance paper needs organization-disjoint data, native safety gold, a real positive reuse class, three-valued evaluation and zero unsound decisions.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns future-responsibility reuse; trust-domain execution custody belongs to ORION-25.
